info.title: Digital Pet web API
info.description: Same-origin, private, uncached API. Google supplies identity only. Local game state stays in IndexedDB. Creation IDs are timestamp-UUID idempotency keys accepted for 14 days. Exact payload models are in digital-pet-online and the shared web protocol validators.
